description: This file contains unit tests for the BonjourEscapes utility, specifically testing its decode function to handle escape sequences in strings.

classes.name: BonjourEscapesTests
classes.description: A test suite that verifies the decoding of escape sequences in strings by the BonjourEscapes utility.

methods.name: decodePassThrough
methods.description: Tests that the decode function correctly returns the original string when there are no escape sequences.

methods.name: decodeSpaces
methods.description: Tests that escape sequences for spaces are correctly decoded to actual space characters.

methods.name: decodeMultipleEscapes
methods.description: Verifies that multiple escape sequences within a string are correctly interpreted and decoded.

methods.name: decodeIgnoresInvalidEscapeSequences
methods.description: Ensures that invalid or incomplete escape sequences are ignored and the string remains unchanged at those points.

methods.name: decodeUsesDecimalUnicodeScalarValue
methods.description: Checks that escape sequences using decimal Unicode scalar values are correctly decoded to their respective characters.
